column1: # Fixed-entry roster: selected agricultural inventors admitted by preparatory committee 1958-06-15
# This is a selected/recognized cohort, not a denominator for national population invention rate.
# The 1958 preparatory committee and 1963 formally established society must not be treated as automatically continuous memberships.
# latest_identified_public_source_date = date of public document, NOT the date of last creative activity, and NOT an observation of exit.
# post1961_personal_record UNKNOWN_NOT_VERIFIED means no uniquely verified later biographical link found in targeted online searches, not that the person stopped inventing.
# Alternative name spellings and locations are unconfirmed until original scans and local archives checked.
